title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: types.h:9–18 defines four conserved variables and ideal-gas parameters; flux.cpp computes 2D conservative Euler flux. This does not validate numerical outcomes.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp:62–72 reads only the first base/zone and :126–130 accepts separate TRI/QUAD sections, not MIXED sections. geometry.cpp computes 2D polygon area; rank-distributed solver keeps a full mesh on every rank.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:89–101,162–170,210–227 assembles local inviscid face contributions; viscous direct-difference implementation :229–275 is limited, and inviscid limiter is globally zero.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: flux.cpp:24–67 implements Rusanov numerical flux; no Roe/Harten assertion required for this report. Low-Mach numerical drag is large.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: boundary.cpp:14–91 implements farfield, slip and no-slip ghost states; output.cpp obtains wall values. Unknown BC strings default to FARFIELD in mesh.cpp:11–21, weakening error handling.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: f679644 solver.cpp:89–96 initializes every limiter to zero; face paths use these factors. report.tex:147–170 claims active second-order/Barth with fallback only, contradicted by submitted source. 12f77fb has same source SHA; earlier cbe40ee also zeroed multipliers. Exact historic binary remains unbound.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: f679644 solver.cpp:89–96 initializes every limiter to zero; face paths use these factors. report.tex:147–170 claims active second-order/Barth with fallback only, contradicted by submitted source. 12f77fb has same source SHA; earlier cbe40ee also zeroed multipliers. Exact historic binary remains unbound.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:173–205 wall viscous treatment and :229–275 direct cell-difference thin-layer gradients; :324–332 explicitly projects wall shear tangentially. High drag remains a result credibility defect, not proof of normal-traction mislabel. output.cpp:77 hardcodes cf=0, and all selected laminar wall rows confirm it despite nonzero viscous drag.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver.cpp:414–452 invokes LU-SGS with steady CFL capped at5 and fixed minimum inner iterations, not a measured steady inner convergence test.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:528–607 implements BDF/inner iteration, but :599–615 updates time histories before logging a new BDF residual; that logged term is not the residual solved in the inner loop. Submitted residual rows all say five iterations; revised metadata max124 contradicts them.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: main.cpp:179–229 keeps a full GlobalMesh on every rank during solver.run; this violates TASK prohibited shortcut 7. METIS partition and neighbor communication are present. Production-source binding is unresolved.
